name: Reetwika Banerjee

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Reetwika Banerjee writes poetry, fiction, travel narratives and practical guides to digital safety. Her work brings together a literary practice and a professional background in information security. Evincepub’s catalogue includes her travel book Mystic Himalayas and Cyber Security at Your Finger Tips; her article for the Goethe-Institut explains online cookies and personal privacy to general readers.

Her Kabita Live poem “Life Without You” gives this varied body of writing an intimate, elegiac voice. The sea offers the sensation of a loved one’s touch, yet each visit ends with empty hands. Waves, wind and sand become witnesses to a grief hidden behind the speaker’s public smile. The poem leaves the reader with the repeated movement between remembered closeness and present absence.
